facts.fact: TechCabal reports that the NIMC Act 2026, which replaced the 2007 Act, has been passed by the President and is operational per a NITDA spokesperson, and makes NIMC the Root Certification Authority responsible for the trust framework for digital signatures; it is an identity law, not an e-commerce law by name.

TechCabal reports that the National Digital Economy and E-Governance Bill, introduced in July 2024, gives qualifying electronic signatures the same validity as handwritten ones and empowers NITDA to accredit certification authorities; it was approved by the House of Representatives by May 2026 and awaited the Senate.
facts.system: National Digital Economy and E-Governance Bill

facts.fact: TechCabal reports that under the NIMC Act 2026 NIMC is designated Nigeria's Root Certification Authority and Issuing Authority for the national PKI, with Section 7(k) making it responsible for validating the certificates underpinning digital signatures; report date used as date of statement.

systems.system: National Public Key Infrastructure (NIMC Root Certification Authority)
